evidence.claim: PolicyDecision is a closed enum (allow, deny, ask_user); engine returns one per call via CheckResult.
Rule evaluation is first-match-wins after priority sort; default is DENY non-interactive and ASK_USER interactive; YOLO short-circuits to ALLOW.
Workspace policy is gated by both folder trust and an integrity hash; loading is skipped when untrusted; modified workspace TOML triggers re-prompt.
Extension-supplied policies cannot grant ALLOW or YOLO-mode rules; the loader strips them on import.
Tool execution is policy-gated at two sites: scheduler._processToolCall via scheduler/policy.ts:checkPolicy, and MessageBus.publish for TOOL_CONFIRMATION_REQUEST.
Engine matching is keyed on FunctionCall.name (with aliases and MCP FQN); synthetic tools have no special-case exemption.

contradictions.description: Guideline cites packages/core/src/core/coreToolScheduler.ts as integration point; actual consumer is packages/core/src/scheduler/scheduler.ts.
FolderTrustDiscoveryService is consumed by UI/extension flows, not directly by the policy engine; engine coupling to trust is only via trustedFolders.ts.

risks.description: advisor_consultation synthetic tool would be denied by default in non-interactive mode unless an explicit ALLOW rule ships.
risks.suggestedGuard: ship packaged-default TOML allow-rule for advisor_consultation gated on Pollux feature flag

risks.description: Dynamic policy updater appends ALLOW rules at runtime; per-turn Pollux updates could grow rule set unboundedly.
risks.suggestedGuard: prohibit Pollux from emitting UPDATE_POLICY messages

risks.description: Engine called from both scheduler and confirmation bus; advisor reaching both paths could prompt twice.
risks.suggestedGuard: route advisor through scheduler path only

risks.description: Extension-stripped ALLOW semantics mean a Pollux extension cannot ship its own allow-rule; only built-in or admin policyPaths works.

gaps: No test for advisor_consultation-style synthetic tool double-prompt avoidance (R-09.3).
No Pollux-specific feature-flag scoped policy bundle (R-09.1).
No published guidance on which channel ships Pollux allow-rule (R-09.4).

openQuestions: OQ-09.1: Should advisor_consultation bypass the engine entirely (in-process metadata vs tool call)? Escalate to 02 and 04.
OQ-09.2: Does synthesis need to add a Pollux-specific rule to packaged default policy? Escalate to 16.

definitionOfDone.item: Policy loading, evaluation, and enforcement pipeline is mapped.
Safety gaps and follow-up recommendations are documented.
Pre-flight path validation recorded in report section 0.
Evidence matrix populated in the JSON sidecar.
